TitleCard.description: Kinetic headline card with impact pop and underline sweep.

llm.use: Big kinetic word or number as the whole shot (a reveal like 'RAW', '2/3').

props.text: impact_reveal: ≤5 Chinese chars or ≤8 letters/digits (auto-shrinks to fit; never cut a term); headline: ≤6 chars

ColorSweep.description: Toon swatch strip sweeping from a colour cast to neutral (white balance / colour correction).

llm.use: White paper under a candle; a colour-temperature slider fixes the cast on reveal.

ParticleStream.description: Deterministic instanced toon particles with trails (photon flow / noise / denoise).

llm.use: Background particles (depth 0).

props.mode: photons (light rain) | converge (flies into the centre)

ChipReveal.description: Hero chip object. Layer B (three.js toon) is a skeleton; 2.5D SVG fallback is implemented.

llm.use: HERO 3D chip slamming down (renderer "three"): ONLY when the protagonist is a chip/processor.

RawFramePlate.description: Pixel plate: photo, guess (photo flips to one-colour tiles + ?), mono, raw (ISP switch off) (colour-blind sensor), bayer (RGGB filters), demosaic (neighbour interpolation).

llm.use: 8×8 pixel plate of the sunset photo.

modes.guess: photo flips into one-colour tiles with '?'
modes.raw: ISP switch flips off, photo fades to dark grey-green RAW
modes.bayer: R/G/B Bayer tiles + RGGB legend on reveal
modes.demosaic: tiles fill in to the photo, arrows into a pixel

ExposureMerge.description: Short and long exposure cards fusing into one tone-mapped card.

llm.use: Dark card + overexposed card merge into one 'both readable' card on reveal.

PipelineFlythrough.description: Stage boxes on a conveyor with camera flythrough; focus highlights one stage.

llm.use: Vertical stack of 2-5 stage capsules lighting in order; a photo token travels down.

props.stages: list of 2-5 names (≤6 chars); camera-pipeline names get icons, others get step numbers
props.top: y of first capsule (≥520 if there is a top headline)
props.perStage: seconds per stage, may be {"spanFrac": f}
props.error: bool: a red error blob grows at each stage, '!' on impact
props.token: bool: a photo card travels down the stages (default true only for camera-pipeline stages)

LensArray.description: Phone camera bump with N toon lenses popping in.

llm.use: Phone camera bump with N lenses.
llm.beats: reveal = highlight sweep; exit = all lenses go dark + red crosses

PhotonGuide.description: Mascot '小光': a photon with eyes; blinks, bobs, squash-and-stretch along velocity, sparkle trail.

llm.use: Mascot 小光 of the camera/ISP series (a photon with eyes), depth 2. Never use when the script says no mascot (无吉祥物).

props.keys: [[frac, x, y, scale], ...] path over the shot

EyeBlinkFrames.description: One human blink vs. the 33 ms frames that fit inside it.

llm.use: An eye blinks while numbered frame cards pop (time scale comparisons).

PhotonWell.description: Pixel wells counting photons: count / gray / filter (Bayer caps).

llm.use: Four glass pixel wells catching photons.

modes.count: photons land, liquid rises, counters tick
modes.filter: R/G/G/B caps drop on, wrong-colour photons bounce

NeighborGrid.description: 3x3 Bayer neighbourhood: ask (G? B?) / average (neighbour values + formula).

llm.use: 3×3 Bayer neighbourhood around a red pixel.

props.mode: ask ('G? B?') | average (neighbour values fly in, formula on impact)

MoireFence.description: Fine fence over the sunset: rainbow false colour (artifact) / edge-directed sweep (fix).

llm.use: Fine fence over the sunset.

props.mode: artifact (rainbow false colour, red ✗ on impact) | fix (arrow sweeps them away, ✓)

PhotonBars.description: Photon arrivals into six pixel columns: stream / day / night (cuts to a noisy night city).

llm.use: Photons falling into six pixel columns.

props.mode: stream (beam breaks into grains on reveal) | day (dense, columns equal) | night (sparse, columns jump; cuts to a noisy night city on impact)

BurstStack.description: Night burst: smear / align / stack / milestones / shutter; noise ~ 1/sqrt(N).

llm.use: Night-photo burst stacking.

props.mode: smear (squeegee wipes detail away, ✗) | align (offset frames register ×1→×6) | stack (×6→×12) | milestones (×1→×16 with 1/2, 1/4 marks) | shutter (ring 1/16→16/16, ✓)

WBCompare.description: White balance panels: temps / brain / wrong / night (learned AWB).

llm.use: White-balance panels.

props.mode: temps (candle-orange vs cloudy-blue paper) | brain (brain fixes, sensor doesn't, ✗) | wrong (yellow face, blue snow, ✗) | night (three coloured lamps, AI icon, paper turns white ✓)

ToneLadder.description: Brightness levels: squeeze (thousands -> 256) / spacing (even vs eye-weighted).

llm.use: Brightness levels.

props.mode: squeeze (thousands of levels into a 256 box, '怎么压？') | spacing (even vs eye-weighted steps)

ToneCard.description: Landscape tone mapping: crush (dead white / black) / lift (shoot dark, lift shadows).

llm.use: Landscape tone mapping.

props.mode: crush (sky dead white, shadows dead black) | lift (shoot dark, lift shadows ✓)

ZoomSwitch.description: Multi-camera colour: grid (four lens tints) / zoom (0.6x->5x, colour jump on hand-over).

llm.use: Multi-camera colour.

props.mode: grid (same scene, four lens tints) | zoom (slider 0.6×→5×, '颜色跳了！' at hand-overs)

TripleISP.description: Three always-on ISP lanes feeding previews (instant zoom switch).

llm.use: Three always-on ISP lanes feeding previews.
GENERIC: 1-6 cards (list, steps, comparison, pros/cons). Use whenever no topic component fits.
llm.beats: entrance = cards pop in order; reveal = values light up; impact = highlight + marks

llm.use: GENERIC: 2-6 bars comparing numbers.
llm.beats: reveal = bars grow; impact = highlight pops
